//: This is an example configuration file for markdown-link-checker.
You can copy this to your project root as .linkcheckerrc.json and customize it.
Timeout for each HTTP/HTTPS request in milliseconds. Default is 10000.
Delay between consecutive HTTP/HTTPS requests in milliseconds to avoid rate-limiting. Default is 100.
Custom User-Agent string for HTTP/HTTPS requests. Defaults to the tool's name and version.
An array of regular expression strings. Any URL matching one of these patterns will be ignored.
